items.title: Kalshi, Polymarket and Crypto.com sue Missouri, Louisiana and Utah officials in federal court, iGaming Times reports
items.content_text: - **Kalshi, Polymarket and Crypto.com sue Missouri, Louisiana and Utah officials in federal court, iGaming Times reports** — Kalshi sued Missouri Attorney General Catherine Hanaway on October 27, Polymarket's US exchange QCX sued Louisiana Attorney General Liz Murrill the same day, and the North American Derivatives Exchange behind Crypto.com's prediction market sued Utah Attorney General Derek Brown on October 26. items.title: Australia ASIC chair says no prediction market operator has applied for a licence and Polymarket is already blocked, Odaily reports
items.content_text: - **Australia ASIC chair says no prediction market operator has applied for a licence and Polymarket is already blocked, Odaily reports** — ASIC Chair Sarah Court told a parliamentary hearing on Thursday that no prediction market operator has applied for an Australian licence, that the platforms may face gambling rather than financial regulation, and that their all-or-nothing mechanism is similar to binary options, which Australia has banned.
